title: Federal Reserve statement
text: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged but signaled that borrowing costs will stay higher for longer. Inflation remains elevated, and the job market continues to show resilience. Investors worry about a potential slowdown in real estate as mortgage rates climb.

title: Tech sector expansion
text: Tech giants announced a series of new artificial intelligence chips, triggering a sector-wide stock rally. Analysts express optimism regarding software and semiconductor companies, although cybersecurity risks and data breaches remain a prominent threat to market stability.

title: Oil price volatility
text: Crude oil prices fell to a multi-year low today amid supply gluts and flagging global trade volume. Safe-haven assets like gold surged in response as investors rotate out of cyclical commodities and equities.

title: Bank merger collapses
text: Merger talks between two regional banks fell through after regulators raised concerns about capital requirements. Shares of both lenders dropped, and analysts said the failed deal could slow consolidation across the banking sector.

title: Housing market cools
text: New housing data shows home sales slowed for a third month as mortgage rates stayed high. Builders reported weaker demand, though some analysts expect a recovery if the central bank begins cutting rates later this year.
